prompt: Grace is going to ask me for concrete examples of where my recent borrower updates and file handling broke down, and I don't want to walk into that conversation with partial notes. Can you get the full picture on the Carlos Mendez and Tiffany Brooks complaints, Taylor Morgan's gift funds issue, and the appraisal problem involving the finished basement? Before you update anything, make sure each item is tied to the right borrower, loan, owner, and current status, since I'm worried some of these may have been passed around or recorded unevenly. Clean up the loan and client records so they show the current blocker, what has already been tried, and who should own the next step. I don't want you to contact borrowers, agents, title, or lenders yet. Send Grace and Elena an action plan in my voice so we can stabilize the files before I give Grace my full explanation.

criteria.criterion: The Agent sends one internal action plan from amy.chen@keystonemortgage.com to grace.yamamoto@keystonemortgage.com and elena.marchetti@keystonemortgage.com.
criteria.evidence: Look for an outbound email where the sender is amy.chen@keystonemortgage.com and the recipients include grace.yamamoto@keystonemortgage.com and elena.marchetti@keystonemortgage.com.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks Amy to send Grace and Elena an action plan before Amy gives Grace the full explanation. This is the main final write action.

criteria.criterion: The Agent does not send any outbound message or email to borrowers, agents, title companies, lenders, appraisers, Taylor Morgan's parents, or other outside parties.
criteria.evidence: Review all outbound email and message actions. Passing requires no outbound communication to external addresses such as borrower emails, realtor emails, title company emails, lender emails, appraiser emails, or parent donor contacts.
criteria.cb_justification: The prompt explicitly says not to contact borrowers, agents, title, or lenders yet. The finished basement issue also involves an appraiser and lender, and the gift funds issue involves parents, so external outreach would violate the requested hold.

criteria.cb_justification: The prompt asks the agent to make sure each item is tied to the right borrower and loan. The key Carlos issue is that the complaint sender and LOS borrower do not match.
